class.name: MaszynaVehicleCommandAction
class.description: A command - its own, or read from a memory when the event runs ([code]Event.cpp:577-844[/code]). What the track does to a vehicle stays with the events: [code]CabSignal[/code] is the cab signal magnet acting on the vehicle that queued the event, and [code]Emergency_brake[/code] a Radio-Stop sent from where the event stands. The rest is an order for the driver of the vehicle that queued the event ([method DriverServer.driver_send_command]).

members.member: Where the event stands: [code]putvalues[/code] x y z, the memory's position for [code]getvalues[/code].
The scenery's radio [code]Emergency_brake[/code] transmits Radio-Stop on.
[code]getvalues[/code]: the memory whose text and values are the command, read when the event runs; empty for the action's own.
